text:
Closing the umbrella. Of the three .13 wrappers:

- ✅ verify_code_signer — PKIX-fmtv.13.1 shipped 2026-05-12.
- ✅ verify_time_stamper — PKIX-fmtv.13.2 shipped 2026-05-12 (with critical-and-sole EKU enforcement per RFC 3161 §2.3, new Error::ProfileViolation variant).
- ⏳ verify_ocsp_responder — PKIX-fmtv.13.3 human-labeled with three substantive design questions filed (issuer param shape, self-signed CA-direct case, id-pkix-ocsp-nocheck shim).

The umbrella scope is fulfilled to the extent it can be without human design input on the OCSP responder wrapper.
